title: Sum of numbers in a range
description:
Declare a function named sum_of_numbers. It takes a number parameter and it adds all the numbers in that range.

print(sum_of_numbers(5))  # 15
print(sum_of_numbers(10)) # 55
print(sum_of_numbers(100)) # 5050
hints: range(1, n + 1) produces every whole number from 1 up to and including n.
The built-in sum() function adds up all the items of an iterable.
expected_behavior: Returns the sum of all whole numbers from 1 to n inclusive.
explanation: range(1, n + 1) generates the numbers 1 through n, and sum() adds them all together in one call.
